faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Punjab & Sind Bank for engaging professionals at their Regional Office in Ludhiana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The post announced in this recruitment notification is Physiotherapist on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been advertised for the Physiotherapist post in Punjab & Sind Bank.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for Punjab & Sind Bank Physiotherapist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must download the form, fill it, attach documents, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the completed offline application form is 26-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualification is required for the Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor or Master's degree in Physiotherapy along with a minimum of 02 years of experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or remuneration offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Physiotherapist position will receive a fixed monthly remuneration of Rs 7200/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Punjab & Sind Bank Physiotherapist?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny of received applications, shortlisting of candidates, calling them for an interview, and final selection.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application should be sent by Ordinary or Speed Post to The Regional Manager, Punjab & Sind Bank, Regional Office Ludhiana, 4th floor jai kartar tower, gobind nagar, ferozepur road, Ludhiana 141001.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form format by visiting the official website of Punjab & Sind Bank at https://punjabandsindbank.bank.in.
